# Theme-guide ordinary browser task costs

Qualification after [INC-52's degraded follow-up](2026-09-16-theme-guide-transport.md):
this retained run has complete bodies and passing recorded numbers, but its timer did
not explicitly require complete stylesheet delivery before observing useful state.
Do not treat those numbers alone as completed useful-view performance acceptance;
a corrected acquisition must bind the full asset barrier to the timing endpoint.

The ordinary first-visit/repeat slice records numbers below its prospective budgets:
120 complete native preview/export/reset journeys have exact bodies and ZIPs checked
independently, but useful-view timing acceptance needs the corrected endpoint above.
`core.themes-style-guide` remains **partial**. Warm-cache, degraded
transport, memory, cancellation and real-consumer acceptance are not established.

## Workload and results

The [browser contract](fixtures/styleguide-performance/browser-contract.md) predates
acquisition. Gallery's actual `NewThemeLab` uses unchanged Synthwave source, dashboard,
components and forms specimens, both schemes,1440×1000 and390×844 viewports.
Five samples of each combination run first in a fresh context, then again in that
context:60 contexts and120 journeys. Native forms edit sans to system-serif, medium
radius to .75rem and light accent to #ff7edb; preview acknowledges the candidate,
export verifies the five-member ZIP, reset restores the source state. No authored
page script, consumer data, licensed assets or source/preferences writes are added.

Apple M4,32GiB RAM, Darwin25.6.0 arm64; Chrome152.0.7977.84; Playwright1.63.0;
Node26.3.0. The retained server was built by Go1.26.3. Timers span the native action
through observed rendered state or saved/verified ZIP, not just response headers.
The complete acquisition took53.674s; these are sample maxima, not population p95s.

| Metric | Largest observed | Predeclared ceiling |
|---|---:|---:|
| Initial useful state | 227.914ms | 1,000ms |
| Acknowledged candidate preview | 136.718ms | 500ms |
| Saved and verified ZIP | 64.666ms | 500ms |
| Reset to source state | 140.726ms | 1,000ms |
| Complete decoded view bodies | 141,623 bytes | 256KiB |
| Candidate ZIP | 16,340 bytes | 1MiB |

All1,560 expected responses are accounted for: four each for initial/preview/reset,
one export per task. Raw bodies are retained and hashed, not inferred from headers.
Playwright transfer sizes, including chunk framing where reported, remain separate
from decoded bytes. Every recorded size must be finite and complete; a failed read
is not zero. Download-navigation `ERR_ABORTED`, when emitted, must bind one-to-one
to the verified saved ZIP response; unrelated aborts remain failures.

The scoped checker rehashes selected tools/source/server, parses the frozen server
build receipt, checks all120 unique task identities, complete request/response
closures, rendered postconditions, transport policy, source labels, archive members,
actual receipt/source/member hashes, transfer accounting and every unchanged budget.
Its40 unit cases include missing/duplicate tasks, nonfinite values, wrong identities,
source labels, missing artifacts, forged exports, failed traffic and excess budgets.
The CLI requires `--scoped`; it always reports `complete:false` for this slice.

## Failed attempts and the cache boundary

- `acquisition-01/` retains120 failures before preview: the harness selected both
  `meta[name=viewport]` and the form control. The repair selects `select[name=viewport]`;
  no application code, expected task, budget or original receipt changed.
- The first eight-test checker at `/Volumes/m2ext/appkit-browser-check.refYzQ/` was
  rejected in review: wrong receipt shape, incomplete matrix acceptance and shared
  mutable test fixtures. It is not acceptance evidence. The replacement's initial34
  tests remain in `checker-1gxjyN/`; the independently reviewed40-case revision adds
  actual-identity, source-label and transfer-accounting checks before acceptance.
- `cache-canary-tmozDw/` retains an incomplete diagnostic: final source reread failed
  EPERM after cleanup, before JSON persistence. No cache result is claimed from it.
- `cache-canary-byPCrf/` disproves parent-target-only CDP blocking. The sandboxed
  same-origin iframe is a separate target; two forbidden fixture-image requests
  escaped through it while parent blocking worked. Both servers were isolated
  loopback fixtures, not external destinations. A real cache hit was observed,
  but containment failed, so this is **not** warm-cache acceptance.
- `cache-canary-vBZs2m/` retains a failed recursive-session candidate: Chrome refuses
  non-flattened browser-level auto-attach. Do not reuse that configuration as a guard.

Playwright routing disables HTTP caching. The passing ordinary lane deliberately
uses that containment and labels repeats honestly. A future cache/degraded lane
must configure and prove every relevant iframe target before acquisition, preserving
the existing no-store documents and opaque sandbox. Memory and cancellation need
their separate fixed-contract workloads. These missing dimensions keep G1/G4 and
the CUE performance gate open; no full starter or native/consumer claim follows.
